## Description

Lists the program files in a directory, identified by extension (`do`, `ado`, `r`, `rmd`, `py`, `ipynb`, `m`, `jl`, `sas`, `sh`, and others; see the `extensions` variable in the script) plus files named `makefile`. When `generated/manifest[.tag].txt` exists, it filters it instead of walking the file tree again.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/04_list_program_files.sh <directory> [tag] [zipfile]
```

- `directory` - Deposit directory, or another directory such as `restricted`.
- `tag` - Optional suffix for the input and output names.
- `zipfile` - Accepted for consistency; not used.

## Outputs

- `generated/programs-list[.tag].txt` - Program files
- `generated/programs-summary[.tag].txt` - One sentence with the count per extension, for the report
- `generated/programs-metadata[.tag].csv` - `filename,lines`; [26_update_jira_software.sh](#help-26_update_jira_software) reads it to detect the software used
